name: Tongue River — Dayton area to Welch Ranch
blurb: Tongue River access research from the Dayton area to Welch Ranch. The long preliminary stretch remains under review; consult the local water-trail guide for documented segments and hazards.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: The takeout is Welch Ranch near the WY 338 bridge. The Dayton-area put-in and this long float still need review. A diversion above Welch requires a portage, and other hazards may be present upstream. The local water-trail guide describes shorter trips; their distances and times do not apply to this full stretch.
sections.accessReview: The Dayton-area put-in and the full long-distance float still need review. Welch Ranch is identified, but the downstream diversion requires a portage; this is not a continuous runnable route.

notices.title: Mandatory portage before Welch Ranch
notices.text: The local float guide identifies a diversion dam roughly one mile before Welch Ranch that must be portaged on the signed river-right route. It also warns of abandoned structures, debris, strainers and occasional agricultural fences. Check current trail conditions and the full guide before planning a trip; no portage line is mapped here.
notices.sourceName: Sheridan Community Land Trust — Tongue River Water Trail

notices.title: Welch Ranch access
notices.text: BLM confirms non-motorized river trips and bridge-side parking at Welch Ranch. Use the designated parking areas; the recreation area is closed to motorized use. The map point is an approximate access area.

gaugeContext.note: The Wyoming State Engineer lists a current Tongue River station near Dayton (06298000), even though the old USGS feed is discontinued. Automated access is not connected yet; Dayton is upstream of the listed Ranchester reaches.
